# Leyoxa

> Leyoxa LLC builds AI for robots and real-world operations: robot perception and autonomy (computer vision, sensor fusion, edge inference), robot fleet and data software (telemetry, pipelines, monitoring, human hand-off), AI agents in production, and security engineering. Research area: AI-assisted commissioning QA for electrical systems (data centers, energy), not yet a commercial offering. Based in Toronto and Austin.

Every page is also published as markdown. Contact: contact@leyoxa.com. Founder: Sepehr Aflatounian (https://sepehrafla.github.io).

## Pages

- [Home](https://leyoxa.com/index.md): What Leyoxa builds, current research, and the founder.
- [Data centers](https://leyoxa.com/data-centers.md): Leyoxa Verify checks switchgear, busway, UPS and PDU terminations against the design before IST, catches hot joints under load-bank testing, and writes the handover package.
- [Energy](https://leyoxa.com/energy.md): Leyoxa Verify checks solar strings, battery storage, substations and on-site power before energization — terminations, labels and test results against the design — and catches hot joints under first load.
- [Questions](https://leyoxa.com/faq.md): Answers about Leyoxa Verify, robotic and AI commissioning QA — technicians, safety around energized equipment, robots, data, standards, pilots and where Leyoxa works.
- [How it works](https://leyoxa.com/how-it-works.md): How Leyoxa Verify inspects terminations, reads test results and writes the handover package, and how an 8–12 week pilot runs alongside your commissioning crew.
- [Manufacturing](https://leyoxa.com/manufacturing.md): Leyoxa Verify checks every panel, feeder and termination in new fabs, battery plants and gigafactories against the design before energization, and documents it for handover.
